title: Delivery and independent training
purpose: Provider delivers a report, is paid upon report acceptance, supports that report for 30 days, and separately supplies an independent training class.

clauses.label: Delivery
clauses.text: Provider delivers the commissioned report to Customer on Friday.

clauses.label: Acceptance payment
clauses.text: Customer pays Provider when Customer accepts the report delivered under the Delivery clause.

clauses.label: Report support
clauses.text: Provider supports the delivered report for 30 days after acceptance.

clauses.label: Independent training
clauses.text: Provider gives an independent Python workshop unrelated to report delivery or acceptance.

note: Fixture expectations are educational hypotheses, not real model consensus receipts or court findings.
